script_text: Taurus, stop everything—your partnership house is blazing today. Early week, Venus conjuncts the Sun in your 7th House, squaring Mars in your 12th House. This Earth energy lights very serious talks with a partner or key business client. Your patience is tested by inner tension, so skip arguments on this Tuesday. Wednesday brings the Full Moon conjunct the North Node in your fiery 1st House. The energy shifts suddenly from 'we' to 'I' and your own path. By Friday, Mercury clears communication lines so your career plans accelerate quickly. Saturday rewards risk-taking; pitch that big financial proposal before Sunday settles in. Wednesday is your power day because the Node returns you to authenticity. Monday is worst because the 7th House glare exposes hidden relationship friction. Trust your gut always just before signing anything, and ground yourself deeply in nature tonight. Follow for more daily updates.
